title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 1, Fugue 9 in E major

character.text: Light verset-style fugue on a simple tonic and dominant plan

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence rising by a fourth every half bar. Returns in Episode 3 (bars 13–16).

sections.label: Subject in E major (Soprano); Subject in B major (Alto)
Link
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times). Returns in Episode 4 (bars 17–19).

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bar 3), with the soprano's line in the bass, a fifth higher. Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject (2 times) and the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times).

sections.label: Subject in C♯ minor, rhythm varied (Soprano)
Episode 3
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 5–6) in part, with the alto's line in the bass, the bass's line in the soprano, transposed. Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1 and the opening of countersubject 1 and a figure from the subject and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Returns in Episode 5 (bars 22–25).

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Reworks Link (bar 9) in part, in the same voices, transposed. Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times) and a figure from the subject. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1 and a figure from the subject and the opening of countersubject 1.

sections.label: Subject in B major, rhythm varied (Soprano); Subject in E major (Alto)
Episode 5
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 3 (bars 13–16) in part, with soprano and alto exchanged, a third higher. Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: free counterpoint.

sections.label: Episode 6
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted. Alto: a figure from the subject and a figure from the subject, inverted. Bass: the opening of the subject.

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1. Alto: free counterpoint. Returns in Episode 2 (bars 10–12).
